meta.name: self-improvement
meta.description: Captures learnings, errors, and corrections to enable continuous improvement. Use when: (1) A command or operation fails unexpectedly, (2) User corrects Claude ('No, that's wrong...', 'Actually...'), (3) User requests a capability that doesn't exist, (4) An external API or tool fails, (5) Claude realizes its knowledge is outdated or incorrect, (6) A better approach is discovered for a recurring task. Also review learnings before major tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录经验教训,持续改进工作方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望每次操作后自动积累经验,避免重复犯错
copy.tagline_en: Capture learnings and errors for continuous improvement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically accumulate experience after each operation and avoid repeating mistakes

howto.what: Claude 会自动记录错误、用户纠正、知识过时等信息到 .learnings/ 文件夹的日志文件中，并在后续任务中参考这些记录来改进表现。
howto.when: 当命令执行失败、用户纠正 Claude、用户请求不存在功能、外部工具出错、Claude 发现知识过时或发现更好的做法时触发。

say.text: 刚才我纠正了你，请记录这次学习。
say.note: Claude 会将纠正内容记入 LEARNINGS.md。

say.text: 这个命令执行失败了，请记录错误。
say.note: Claude 会将失败详情记入 ERRORS.md。

say.text: 我希望你能支持批量处理功能。

howto.what_en: Claude automatically logs errors, corrections, outdated knowledge, etc. to .learnings/ files and references them in future tasks to improve performance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a command fails, user corrects Claude, user requests a missing feature, external tool fails, Claude realizes knowledge is outdated, or a better approach is found.

say_en.text: I just corrected you, please log this learning.
say_en.note: Claude logs the correction into LEARNINGS.md.

say_en.text: This command failed, please log the error.
say_en.note: Claude logs the failure into ERRORS.md.

say_en.text: I wish you could support batch processing.
say_en.note: Claude logs this request into FEATURE_REQUESTS.md.
